package.description: Transwiz - User Profile Transfer Wizard - makes it easy to transfer your personal data and settings to a new computer.

en-US.description: Transwiz - User Profile Transfer Wizard - makes it easy to transfer your personal data and settings to a new computer.
en-US.longDescription: Transwiz enables you to move a user's profile and assign it to any user account on any domain in any language. By separating the user account from the user data, Transwiz enables you to move user accounts as well as computers.
en-US.name: ForensiT Transwiz
